text: {"original_span": "Because the standard error on PGR is large relative to the separation from the baseline, the observed gap falls within two standard errors, so this run does not establish an improvement over the baseline; the direction is suggestive but the four-seed sample is too small to support a confident claim.", "new_span": "The separation from the baseline exceeds the standard error on PGR, so this run establishes an improvement over the baseline, though the four-seed sample remains modest.", "flaw_type": "c", "metric": "pgr_se", "why": "The 0.24 gap is under two standard errors (0.14), so significance cannot be claimed."}
